prose.def: An adverb meaning "beyond" or "on the far side of," pointing to something past a stated place.
prose.article: ἐπέκεινα is a spatial adverb meaning "beyond" or "on the further side of," typically used with a genitive to mark what lies past a given point. In the Septuagint it appears 16 times and most often (12×) translates the Hebrew הָלְאָה, "onward" or "beyond." Its single New Testament appearance, in Acts 7:43, is itself a Septuagint quotation, where the phrase speaks of being carried away "beyond Babylon."
